title: Implement GC candidate selection query
description:
Implement a query against the article metadata SQLite store that returns all CIDs that are: (a) stored locally, (b) not covered by any current pinning policy rule, (c) older than the configured GC grace period (default 1h after ingestion). Returns a Vec<Cid> of GC candidates. Artifact: transit/src/retention/gc_candidates.rs.

Acceptance:
- Articles covered by a pin rule are excluded from candidate set
- Articles within grace period are excluded
- Query is efficient (uses index on ingestion_time)
- Unit test: insert 20 articles, pin 8, verify 12 returned as candidates
